reason: Delivery estimates are effectively tied (696.5 vs 690.6), but C11 has more major episodes (28 vs 21) and higher importance_flow (1141.19 vs 951.87). His work is one durable, completed program: the flag_evaluations migration ran from cutover (#110254) through the HogQL rewrite (#124397) to rollout-flag removal (#126076), and he also closed the deletion-compliance paths (#117395, #82056) and CDP/flags data-loss failures (#121819, #108772). C15's security fixes (#113013, #105547) are highly critical and his cross-team reach is wider (25 vs 14 teams, trust_rank 0.0215 vs 0.0131), but they are many point fixes, the hog CLI (ws5) has not replaced posthog-cli yet, and his quality_rate (0.945, P10) and single-reviewer concentration on security majors are weaker than C11's 0.966, which offsets C11's first-pass red flag and four HogQL follow-up fixes.
